chapters.caption: Layer 100 (z 3 mm): first border (red) around the hatch (green)
Turn on the Start Points overlay
Start point shift Off: every layer starts the border at the same point (the seam)
Contours › First border › Start point shift
Stay at least 1 mm away from the start points of the last 3 layers
Now the start point moves from layer to layer: the seams are spread around the part
Line stipple: switch from off to on
2 passes: the second pass fills the gaps of the first
Zoom to the right edge, hatch already exposed
Animation: the border is exposed as 2 mm dashes, then the gaps are closed
